_note: Khand words. Goal lines are lesson content in the child's language (en / hinglish / hi); {slot} = a value the law gives. Controls are English chrome (G-EN-1). No verdict words, no praise, no pressure.

views.build3.en: Build it so all three pictures match.
views.build3.hinglish: Aisa banao ki teeno chitra mil jaayein.
views.build3.hi: ऐसा बनाओ कि तीनों चित्र मिल जाएँ।

views.same.en: Build a different one, same from the {view}.

array.fill.en: Fill the pit, then say how many.
array.fill.hinglish: Gaddha bharo, phir bolo kitne lage.
array.fill.hi: गड्ढा भरो, फिर बोलो कितने लगे।

array.fill3.en: How many blocks fill the pit exactly?
array.fill3.hinglish: Kitne blocks se gaddha theek bharega?
array.fill3.hi: कितने ब्लॉक से गड्ढा ठीक भरेगा?

array.turn.en: Same array, turned. Same number of blocks?
array.turn.hinglish: Wahi array, ghooma hua. Utne hi blocks?
array.turn.hi: वही ऐरे, घूमा हुआ। उतने ही ब्लॉक?

floor.area.en: Lay one floor of exactly {n} tiles.

floor.perimeter.en: A rectangle floor with a fence of {n}.

floor.max.en: Fence of {n}: the most floor you can.

floor.min.en: {n} tiles of floor: the least fence.
floor.min.hinglish: {n} tiles ka farsh: sabse kam baad.
floor.min.hi: {n} टाइलों का फ़र्श: सबसे कम बाड़।

powers.square.en: Squares {terms}, ... Say the next, then build it.

powers.cube.en: Cubes {terms}, ... Say the next, then build it.

mirror.x.en: Build the other half, as in the glass.
mirror.x.hinglish: Doosra aadha banao, jaise shishe mein.
mirror.x.hi: दूसरा आधा बनाओ, जैसे शीशे में।

mirror.z.en: The glass lies flat. Build the other half.
mirror.z.hinglish: Shisha leta hai. Doosra aadha banao.
mirror.z.hi: शीशा लेटा है। दूसरा आधा बनाओ।
